commands.assertions: Fresh and reused attempts with the same context and acceptance keys produce comparable cohorts; failures and missing-duration denominators remain visible; mismatched context is rejected as incomparable; a reused result with fewer required assertions is marked assertion_regression and cannot be counted as a speedup.

assertions: Cohort comparison requires both cold and warm operator samples.
Failures and missing effort are retained in each denominator.
Context or acceptance mismatch cannot be reported as a comparable speedup.
A reused cohort with fewer completed assertions than the fresh baseline is rejected as an assertion regression.
limitations: Durable cross-run Vrooli Memory persistence and the fixed 50/30/20 corpus remain open.
